title: Material Manifest Contract
purpose: Defines the versioned material-manifest format that declares every source path eligible for installation, its destination path, role, operation, source type, and mode policy for deterministic repository bootstrapping.

normative_requirements.text: The maintained material manifest shall be a single UTF-8 encoded JSON file at `product/scripts/initializer/framework-inventory.json` in the source repository, declared with schema_version and an entries array.

Each manifest entry shall be a JSON object defining: `source_path` (repository-relative source path), `destination_path` (repository-relative destination path), `role` (one of the material role classifications), `operation` (one of the supported operations), `source_type` (the expected Git object type: blob, tree, or symlink), `mode` (the expected Git mode string such as 100644 or 100755), and optional `profile` and `exclusion_rationale`.

The manifest shall support at least the following operations: `copy-verbatim` (destination bytes equal source Git blob bytes with no encoding or newline changes, source commit and path recorded, mode follows the declared policy, filesystem timestamps do not participate), `instantiate-template` (destination produced from an exact template with only declared substitution fields permitted, defined escaping rules, canonical serialization, and explicit behavior for missing fields), and `generate-record` (destination produced by serializing a governing schema from source fields using canonical field order and canonical JSON encoding).

The manifest shall not rely on broad recursive directory copying as the authority for any path; every output path shall be declared by exactly one manifest entry, and overlapping or duplicate entries shall be rejected as invalid.

Source paths in the manifest shall be interpreted relative to the root of the source commit tree; destination paths shall be interpreted relative to the root of the generated repository/ directory in the staging transaction root.
The manifest schema_version shall be the constant string `1` for this version; future versions shall increment schema_version and shall not silently merge unknown entry fields.
